title: Daily Temperatures
description: Given daily temperatures, return for each day how many days you must wait for a warmer temperature, or 0 if there is none.

reference.use_case: For each point in a time series, finding how long until the value is next exceeded, such as days until a stock trades above today's price or time until a metric breaches its current level.
system_examples: Trading analytics — 'next higher price' and stock-span indicators on price charts
Monitoring systems — computing time-to-next-breach for latency or capacity series
Weather and climate analytics — days until the next warmer day or record high
reference.explanation: A monotonic decreasing stack of unresolved indices answers every 'next greater element' query in one O(n) pass, since each index is pushed and popped once. This powers stock-span indicators and other next-breakout computations on time series.
